about: Every Bible quote in the Faith pack. 'short': which words of the full verse (split on spaces) each translation's quote keeps. Made by scripts/bible/make-quotes.py.

quotes.text: This is the day that the LORD has made
All Scripture is God-breathed
Justified through faith, we have peace with God
By grace you have been saved through faith
There is one mediator between God and men
To Him be the glory forever!
Buried with Him in baptism
Do this in remembrance of Me
Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season
Your word is a lamp to my feet
God is our refuge and strength
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want
We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure
I am the vine and you are the branches
A city on a hill cannot be hidden
The LORD is my rock, my fortress
The water I give him will become in him a fount of water
I am the bread of life
A few people, only eight souls, were saved through water
I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved
Put on the full armor of God
The sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God
I have set My rainbow in the clouds
I will be their God, and they will be My people
The heavens declare the glory of God
Not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father
The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few
Go and make disciples of all nations
The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed
When he found one very precious pearl... sold all he had
You are the salt of the earth
A wise man who built his house on the rock
Small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life
Sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs
May my prayer be set before You like incense
Let us not neglect meeting together
With the overseers and deacons
He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world
He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness
There is now no condemnation
You received the Spirit of adoption to sonship
He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver
Let us run with endurance the race set out for us
He will receive the crown of life
With the trumpet of God
On either side of the river stood a tree of life
The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul
There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God
Repent and believe in the gospel!
Contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints
He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree
His mercies never fail. They are new every morning
You shall have no other gods before Me
You shall not make for yourself an idol
You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain
Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy
Honor your father and mother
You shall not murder
You shall not commit adultery
You shall not steal
You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor
You shall not covet
Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One
In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
Every good and perfect gift... coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last
The wind blows where it wishes... So it is with everyone born of the Spirit
Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit
The word of our God stands forever
Who works out everything by the counsel of His will
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps
Sin entered the world through one man
Look to the heavens and count the stars
No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him
He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out
Justified freely by His grace
No longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir
Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord
By faith Abraham... obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going
God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life
Created in Christ Jesus to do good works
He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion
That you may know that you have eternal life
How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!
It is for freedom that Christ has set us free
His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth
Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’
Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities
They will become one flesh
I will build My church
They devoted themselves... to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread
Go and make disciples... baptizing them
We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death
You proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes
I am the resurrection and the life
And books were opened
The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still
Be holy, because I am holy
The LORD bless you and keep you
You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart
As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!
Everyone did what was right in his own eyes
Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God
The LORD sees the heart
Your throne will be established forever
The LORD, He is God! The LORD, He is God!
Those who are with us are more than those who are with them
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good
If My people... humble themselves and pray
Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD
The joy of the LORD is your strength
For such a time as this?
I know that my Redeemer lives
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge
To everything there is a season
I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valley
He was pierced for our transgressions
Like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand
His mercies never fail
I will give you a new heart
My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions
I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them
Return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious
Let justice roll on like a river
The kingdom will belong to the LORD
Salvation is from the LORD!
To act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress
The righteous will live by faith
He will rejoice over you with gladness
Consider carefully your ways
Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit
The sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings
Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews?
The Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve
She gave birth to her firstborn, a Son... and laid Him in a manger
In the beginning was the Word
You will be My witnesses... to the ends of the earth
I am not ashamed of the gospel
And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love
We have this treasure in jars of clay
Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone
I press on toward the goal to win the prize
In Him all things hold together
So we will always be with the Lord
Do not grow weary in well-doing
The church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race
The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone
No longer as a slave, but... as a beloved brother
The new and living way opened for us through the curtain
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only
You also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house
A lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises
God is love
Walking in the truth
No greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth
To Him who is able to keep you from stumbling
Behold, I make all things new
Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
He is not here; He has risen.
He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
The righteous will live by faith.
The Light shines in the darkness.
For unto us a child is born.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
The LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you.
